response.title: which solar inverter wastes the least power when idle
response.answer:
If your priority is minimizing power consumption when no appliances are running, look for an inverter with very low no-load consumption (also called idle draw or quiescent power).

The best choice depends on whether you're using an off-grid battery system, a hybrid solar system, or a grid-tied system.

For off-grid solar, a good inverter can consume less than 5 W in standby or search mode, while some large hybrid inverters continuously consume 40–100 W or more.

|---|---:|---:|
| Victron Phoenix 250 | 5 W | 1 W |
| Victron Phoenix 375 | 6 W | 1 W |
| Victron Phoenix 500 | 7 W | 1 W |
| Victron Phoenix 800 | 8 W | 1 W |
